title: Deeper/broader HATCH group-47 presence and strict-writer boundary review
mode: primary-source DXF specification and peer-issue research with scoped local parser/writer/test audit
scope: Reconcile Autodesk's HATCH group-47 field definition with conflicting observations in ACadSharp issue #1253
Audit local HATCH and MPOLYGON group-47 parsing, state, output, and current generated test coverage
Screen adjacent ACadSharp reports for existing local test/plan ownership and avoid duplicate work
Refine the existing 7AH/7Z implementation-ready gate without changing the code queue or validation cadence

method.kind: Read-only primary-source issue/spec review and scoped source/test inspection
method.limitations: Autodesk's reference does not specify the conditional group-47 presence rule. The ACadSharp #1253 observations refer to different versions/profiles and referenced samples were not independently acquired or inspected. Static local inspection is not a runtime or strict-consumer reproduction. Adjacent peer issues #1282 and #1283 were treated as title-level leads only.

sources.observed: Group 47 is described as pixel size for associative/flood hatch computations and appears between pattern-line data and group-98 seed-point count. The reference does not define an always-optional/mandatory rule, a derived-path predicate, or the semantics of explicit zero versus omission.

sources.revision: Issue body and later activity reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The original reporter, measuring ACadSharp 3.6.35 against AutoCAD 2027 and an AC1024 DXFOUT comparison, says zero-valued group 47 was omitted in observed native output and reports rejection when the peer writer emitted it. A later contributor cites a different AC1032 sample and says AutoCAD-saved code 47 appears exactly for derived-boundary paths (flag 92=7), with TrueView requiring it for a derived hatch. The samples and outputs were not independently inspected, so these observations are not reconciled or elevated to a universal rule.

sources.revision: #1280 and #1281 bodies plus current issue index reviewed 2026-10-18; #1282/#1283 title-level leads only
sources.observed: #1280 reports culture-sensitive codepage-token lookup under Turkish/Azeri locales. #1281 reports peer stack overflow for repeated comments, XDATA application blocks, and clip boundary groups, with reported ASCII thresholds; these are not local results or format limits. #1282/#1283 were treated as title-level leads only, without a root-cause claim. Existing local codepage and robustness owners already cover the relevant test classes.

sources.revision: Merged PR reviewed 2026-10-18; merged commit 8a52782 on 2026-08-18
sources.observed: The PR adds configurable decimal precision to the ASCII writer and closes issue #1179. This reinforces pinning exact peer artifact/configuration for numeric comparison; it adds no local finding.

localAudit.parser: DRW_Hatch::parseCode(47) reads the double into pixelSize and does not retain a presence bit; DRW_Hatch initializes pixelSize to 0.0.
localAudit.writer: writeHatch and writeMPolygon both emit group 47 only when pixelSize != 0.0.
localAudit.existingTest: The generated HATCH reference owner includes a derived loop with flags 7 and default zero pixelSize, but local round-trip coverage does not establish the strict consumer's required group-47 presence rule.

assessment.planImpact: Refines the existing 7AH/7Z group-47 question into a generated profile matrix and a composed strict-consumer gate. It records the conflict between zero-value and derived-boundary observations, identifies the local absent-versus-zero model collapse, and defers any writer/API change until the conditional presence contract is evidenced. Nearby peer reports remain mapped to existing local robustness, codepage, and numeric owners.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep HATCH and MPOLYGON grammar/results distinct even though the Autodesk page documents group 47 for both.
Before changing output, identify valid cases that vary fill kind, derived-path state, and pixel-size absent/zero/nonzero one factor at a time.
Use the existing generated HATCH test owner for ASCII/Binary raw ordered-tag checks and a group-98/next-record sentinel; do not add downloaded or persistent fixtures or a CTest registration.

Resolve required/omitted group-47 behavior from a primary producer artifact or pinned strict-consumer result with exact app/build, AC version, hashes, path flags, fill kind, value/presence, diagnostic, and readback captured.
Add a public presence field only if absent and explicit zero are proven semantically or round-trip distinct; include copy/reset and both writer routes if needed.

On an implementation slice, limit validation to the touched strict target, focused HATCH selector, relevant LibreCAD compatibility check, and owning focused CTest; keep native/peer runs and broad safety suites at existing composed checkpoints.
Reuse existing local codepage, repeated-record robustness, and exact numeric owners for ACadSharp #1280/#1281/#1179; do not copy peer thresholds or infer local defects from peer issue titles.
